title: Venetian Inscriptions in Cyprus (La Lettera e il Leone)
institution: Ca' Foscari University of Venice (Lorenzo Calvelli) and The Cyprus Institute (STARC)
license_note: The only rights notice on the platform is the footer '(c) La Lettera e il Leone, All Right Reserved'; there is no about, terms or licence page, and the EpiDoc XML downloads carry an empty placeholder in <availability><licence target="...">...</licence>. The site calls itself an Open Access platform, but no open licence is given (checked 2026-10-13).
notes: Open access platform of Latin Renaissance inscriptions from Venetian-ruled Cyprus (1474-1571) with interpreted and diplomatic transcriptions, English and Italian translations, apparatus and photos; no login needed (the LogIn link is for editors). 27 inscriptions in total on 17 sites: 24 are dated within or overlapping 1450-1700 (15 with numeric years, 9 with approximate dates such as 'end of the 15th century'), 1 is Janus I's epitaph of 1432, 2 are illegible fragments with 'Uncertain' dates. No bulk download or TEI export found. Pages modified as late as September 2024. Related: the Titulus/ERC GRAPH-EAST corpus covers Cyprus (575 texts) but is not yet published online. Verbal dates such as 'end of the 15th century' are converted to approximate years, so the share within 1450-1700 is approximate. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
